description: This file defines the SourceMapGenerator class for creating source maps in PHP. It includes methods for adding mappings, generating JSON output, and saving to a file, primarily used in compiling or transpiling processes involving source code mapping.

classes.name: SourceMapGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating source maps in JSON format, managing mappings between original source files and generated code, and exporting the source map information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of SourceMapGenerator with optional configuration options.

methods.name: addMapping
methods.description: Adds a new mapping between generated and original source positions.

methods.name: saveMap
methods.description: Saves the generated source map content to a specified file.

methods.name: generateJson
methods.description: Generates the source map as a JSON string, including optional prefixes.

methods.name: getSourcesContent
methods.description: Retrieves the contents of all source files referenced, used when outputting sourcesContent.

methods.name: generateMappings
methods.description: Creates the encoded mapping string for the source map based on added mappings.

methods.name: findFileIndex
methods.description: Finds the index of a source file in the sources array, used internally for encoding mappings.

methods.name: normalizeFilename
methods.description: Normalizes file paths, resolving paths to a consistent format and removing base path prefixes.

methods.name: fixWindowsPath
methods.description: Converts Windows backslash paths to forward slashes for consistency.
